item.title: Are church services suspended? Email us and we will publish closure lists this weekend
item.description: Is your church suspending services this Sunday, due to inclement weather? Please send us an email at wpjnewsla@gmail.com and we will post it later today and tomorrow. Please include the name and address of the church. Thank you and everyone stay safe!
